command_templates.name: parse_sum_db
command_templates.when: When analyzing a SUM database from a domain controller.

usage_description: SumECmd is used to parse the System Update Manager (SUM) database, providing authentication history and DNS resolution information within a domain.

suspicious_indicators.pattern: Multiple failed login attempts from a single IP address.
suspicious_indicators.description: Indicates potential brute force or reconnaissance activity.

suspicious_indicators.pattern: DNS resolution for an unknown host with a high frequency of access.
suspicious_indicators.description: May indicate a compromised system or malicious activity.

known_false_positives: Normal domain usage may result in frequent authentication attempts from legitimate users.
Common DNS queries are expected and do not necessarily indicate malicious activity.
